meta.notes: M4 cops-3 head start: the cops' taser, as the content-pack doc sketches it (shock, cop-issue, 6 charges, a 0.9 s stun). Six swings and it is spent, whoever holds it; a stolen one keeps the charges it has left. The stun stops the target attacking, shakes the bike and bleeds some speed. Long reach for the darts. Crude starting numbers, [default].
